subject: Exception conditions
notes: Rule: §14.6.13.1.5 2) plus the RAISE paragraph (cite.py --check 14.6.13.1.5 "The last exception status is set to indicate that an exception object has been raised" -> OK 2); "execution continues with the statement following the RAISE statement" -> OK). SetObject sets LastName to the object sentinel (EXCEPTION-STATUS answers 'EXCEPTION-OBJECT'); EmitRaiseObject runs __EcObjDispatch and on -1/-2/-3 continues after the RAISE, never throwing (an object is nonfatal, §14.6.13.1.1 cite.py OK). Golden oo_ec_raise_object: F4 USE AFTER EO CERR1 selected for a CSUB1 object (subclass), 'BASE-HANDLER EXCEPTION-OBJECT / REGISTER-SET / AFTER-RAISE' - status, declarative and continuation-after-RAISE; the no-declarative half is conformance-test:OoSpineTests.RaiseObject_NoDeclarative_ContinuesNextStatement ('CONTINUED'). The trailing lead-in 'If an exception object is raised by an EXIT or GOBACK statement, one of the following occurs' is adjudicated on the four L2 rows. || editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (ISO 2002 OO/EC model)
